cases.title: Verified L1 reconstruction and parent ordering
cases.evidence: 35 focused summary-v2 and memory-atom tests passed, including UTF-8 and special-character fixtures.

cases.title: Single authoritative scan and incremental refresh
cases.evidence: The planner test observes exactly one read_all_raw call; later runs load the persisted plan and refresh only sidecars and failure receipts.

cases.title: Conflicting valid candidates do not halt unrelated work
cases.evidence: The real plan quarantined only L1-000450 and left 457 L1 nodes ready. Both candidate paths and projection hashes were retained.

cases.title: Source drift and unsafe output roots fail closed
cases.evidence: Focused tests quarantine source-hash drift and reject output inside the authoritative archive.

cases.title: Bounded execution and retry
cases.evidence: Each explicit run is capped at 20 nodes, concurrency at 3 model calls, and failures at 3 attempts before quarantine.

cases.title: Authoritative archive remains immutable
cases.evidence: A real baseline and post-plan comparison checked 526 raw and summary-v1 files with zero byte changes.

cases.title: Unscoped historical model send is blocked
cases.evidence: The first three-node semantic run was rejected because prior authorization covered only job-000493, proving that installation and planning do not imply broader data-exfiltration authorization.

cases.title: Authorized historical semantic canary
cases.evidence: No new historical source was sent and no new V2 sidecar was generated. Explicit user approval for broader Codex model processing is still required.
